hooks.name: Guard Protected Files
hooks.description: Blocks writes to expected-hauntings.json, docs/brief/**, .env*, and paths outside workspace

hooks.name: Guard Protected Files (shell)
hooks.description: Blocks shell commands that name expected-hauntings.json, docs/brief or .env together with a writing operation (redirection, cp, mv, rm, Set-Content, writeFile and so on). Reads stay allowed.
